Name: SMALLBASE_AND_SPOT_DEFINE_ST
Description: Site types (Ruins, Field Boss, Night Horde, Evergaol...). Each row lists the SmallBaseMapVariationParam maps that belong to the type, its world map icons and its invader weight. Rows 1xx/2xx are used on the normal maps, 11xx/12xx on the Great Hollow, 21xx/22xx on the second pattern set; attach points say which types may stand on them.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Set: the row is left out of the network test build. Retail: set on 73 of 107 rows.

Fields.Name: Map ID: 1
Fields.Description: SmallBaseMapVariationParam ID of a map that belongs to this site type. A placed site whose map is in Map ID 1-30 counts as this type. -1: empty slot.

Fields.Name: Map ID: 19
Fields.Description: As Map ID 1. -1: empty slot. Retail: used only on row 1111.

Fields.Name: World Map Point Icon ID: 1
Fields.Description: Main icon of the site's world map pin. 0: none.

Fields.Name: Unknown Pin Value
Fields.Description: Passed to the site's world map pin together with World Map Point Icon ID 1. Its effect is not established. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Detail Icon ID: 1
Fields.Description: First detail icon on the world map pin of a site of this type (e.g. 40804, 40807). 0: none.

Fields.Name: Detail Icon ID: 2
Fields.Description: Second detail icon on the site's pin, as Detail Icon ID 1. 0: none.

Fields.Name: Detail Icon ID: 3
Fields.Description: Third detail icon on the site's pin, as Detail Icon ID 1. 0: none.

Fields.Name: Detail Icon ID: 4
Fields.Description: Fourth of the eight detail icons copied to the placed site with Detail Icon ID 1-3. 0: none. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Detail Icon ID: 5
Fields.Description: Fifth detail icon, as Detail Icon ID 4. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Detail Icon ID: 6
Fields.Description: Sixth detail icon, as Detail Icon ID 4. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Detail Icon ID: 7
Fields.Description: Seventh detail icon, as Detail Icon ID 4. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Detail Icon ID: 8
Fields.Description: Eighth detail icon, as Detail Icon ID 4. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Unlock Map Point
Fields.Description: Set: the WorldMapPointParam rows linked to a site of this type are unlocked on the world map. Retail: set on buildings (Ruins, churches, forts, Sorcerer's Rise, Evergaol, Township, Castle), clear on bosses, events and Night Horde.

Fields.Name: Invasion Icon ID
Fields.Description: Copied to the placed site with the detail icons; no use of it found. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Invasion Weight
Fields.Description: Weight of this site type in the draw for which placed site gets invaders (only types that have a placed site count). 0: never chosen. Retail: 100 on Ruins, Great Church and a few Great Hollow rows.

Fields.Name: World Map Point Icon ID: 2
Fields.Description: Replaces the linked WorldMapPointParam row's State Icon 1 on the site's pin. 0: keep the row's icon.

Fields.Name: World Map Point Icon ID: 3
Fields.Description: Replaces the linked WorldMapPointParam row's State Icon 2 on the site's pin. 0: keep the row's icon.

Fields.Name: World Map Point Icon Flag: 2
Fields.Description: Option passed with World Map Point Icon ID 2 (combined with the WorldMapPointParam row's State Icon 1 flag). Its effect is not established. Retail: set on Sorcerer's Rise and Evergaol rows.

Fields.Name: World Map Point Icon Flag: 3
Fields.Description: Option passed with World Map Point Icon ID 3 (combined with the WorldMapPointParam row's State Icon 2 flag). Its effect is not established. Retail: set on the Evergaol rows.

Fields.Name: Unknown Pin Value 2
Fields.Description: Only the low 16 bits are read: passed to the site's world map pin in the slot WorldMapPointParam fills from its own value at the same place. Its effect is not established. Retail 0 on every row.
